title: Energy-guided Entropic Neural Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 把 EOT 弱对偶写成单势 EBM 目标，条件 plan ∝ exp((f(y)−c(x,y))/ε) 用 Langevin 采样；对偶间隙 = ε·KL(π*‖π^f)，并给 Rademacher 泛化界
tldr_en: Recasts the weak dual of entropic OT as an EBM over a single potential; conditional plans are Gibbs measures sampled by Langevin, with dual gap equal to epsilon times KL and Rademacher generalization bounds.
key_numbers: Theorem 2: F* - F(f) = eps * KL(pi* || pi^f) for every dual potential f (Eq. 16)
Theorem 4: E KL(pi* || pi^{f_hat}) <= eps^{-1}[4 R_N + 4 R_M] + eps^{-1}[approximation gap] (Eq. 19)
